_about: Person shapes for the 1,000-person Singapore seed: who they are, what they came to do, how engaged they run. Distributions are a starting point for the owner to adjust. Every shape gets real activities, real places and real-looking data from the other files here.

engagement_tiers.very_high: Daily or several times a week: centre regulars, volunteers, gardeners, choir/karaoke, leaders. ~250 people. They run streaks, host events, answer each other.
engagement_tiers.high: Weekly classes and gatherings, replies to check-ins, goes to market days. ~350 people.
engagement_tiers.steady: Comes monthly, reads nudges, occasionally shares a story. ~250 people.
engagement_tiers.gentle: New or quiet: opened an account, one interest, low activity - exactly who the daily check-in reaches out to. ~150 people.

roles_mix.connect: stay connected and active - most of the 60+ band
roles_mix.share: share what they know - retired professionals, aunties who cook, uncles who fix
roles_mix.care: family members looking after a parent

family_and_channels.family: about 40% have a family ring (helper daughter/son, assisted profile for a parent); the rest solo

family_and_channels.checkin: daily check-in enabled for ~200 gentle/quiet people, local times 08:00-20:30, family_notify only for those who agreed

seed_density_rules: Each town with a real centre gets 20-60 people; centres are the anchor for circles and market days
Every very-high-engagement person belongs to at least one circle AND does one volunteering thing
Circles: 40-60 total - mix of origin, faith/festival, place, life and interest feelings; some imported from the AACs above, some started by people; men-only and women-only circles included
Wisdom: 120-180 elders with capsules (cultural/social/professional), ~80 offers (mix free/paid), ~200 learner requests, ~60 introductions in progress, ~40 logged sessions
Marketplace: 8-12 hosts (real AACs + malls), 40-60 opportunities (market days, volunteering, gigs, shows), 10 market days with stalls
History matters: 6-12 months of gatherings, streaks, check-ins, conversations - a matured system, not a fresh one
